mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of observations where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative or flat (<=0%).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate (exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a three-month period) signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive or flat (>=0%).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) and weak job growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1% monthly) indicates a severe labor market contraction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0.1%, the 20-day forward returns are positive or flat (>=0%).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 430000.0 million dollars) signals that the economy is approaching a peak, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of late-cycle expansion instances where RSAFS > 430000.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive or flat (>=0%).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive or flat (>=0%).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high housing starts (HOUST > 950.0) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 435000.0) indicates an overheated economy in the housing and consumer sectors, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during a late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of late-cycle expansion instances where HOUST > 950.0 and RSAFS > 435000.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive or flat (>=0%).

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 950.0) indicate a strong housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of instances where HOUST > 950.0, the 5-day forward returns are negative or flat (<=0%).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy actions increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of monetary tightening cycle instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5), the 60-day forward returns are positive or flat (>=0%).
